in_marathi.name: Anadi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anadi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anadi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anad’ which means ‘beginning’ or ‘primordial’. In Hindu mythology, Anadi is often used to refer to the primordial god, Brahma, who is believed to be the creator of the universe.
